blocks.cap: 图 17 · 安装步骤 ①-②（图上排 1/2） / Installation Steps 1-2 (Part 1/2)
pairs: ① Detach the mounting bracket from the lamp body.
② 在天花板上钻安装孔，打入膨胀胶塞（木天花板不用打胶塞），用自攻螺丝把挂板固定在天花板上，并确定安装牢固。

② Drill mounting holes in the ceiling and insert expansion plugs (not required for wooden ceilings). Fix the mounting bracket to the ceiling with self-tapping screws and make sure it is firmly seated.
②（续）将 220V 试电接到端子台一端，火线接 L，零线接 N。
② (cont.) Connect the 220V test lead to one end of the terminal block — live wire to L, neutral wire to N.
